description: Fixed question set for Stage 6 go/no-go evaluation. Shared source of truth between the training pipeline's own manual review and backend/api/scripts/eval-local-llm.ts, which runs these against the real serving path. Categories: inDomainRephrased (tests generalization, not memorization — none of these use the exact training-data wording), smallTalk (checks general coherence didn't regress), outOfScope (checks the model still hedges/declines per the system prompt rather than inventing tenant-specific facts).
